[bold #D75FFF]◆ EPIC bob-cli-2n[/bold #D75FFF]
[dim]  Title: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]Named and linked project tasks with ` :id` in `bob capture` and Bob[/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]         [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]Mac Capture[/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]   Goal: [#D7D7AF][/dim]A project-note capture (`@route^id+` or `@route^id+#pomodoro`) can [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]name any of its task bullets with a trailing ` ^id`, or name them [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]and link them into the current/next (or named) Pomodoro with a [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]trailing ` :id`. The `^prj` task is never linked, the retired [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]`@route:id+` forms fail with a message that teaches the new [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]spelling, and Bob Mac Capture highlights, completes, previews, and [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]reports the new syntax.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim] Counts: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]6[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] phases[dim][/dim] · [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]4[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] waves[/dim]

[dim] Prompt: [#87AFFF][/dim]prompts/202609/project_task_links.md[/#87AFFF]

[dim]  1 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Project-note marker grammar: `@route^id+#pomodoro`, retire [/bold #D7AFFF]   [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
      [bold #D7AFFF]`@route:id+`[/bold #D7AFFF]
    [#AF87FF]marker[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]marker: move the Pomodoro name onto the `^` project-note marker [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF](`@route^id+#pomodoro`), retire the `:` project-note forms with teaching[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]errors, stop linking or starring `^prj`, and keep execution, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]capture-parse, capture-complete, and help text in agreement.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  2 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Project task IDs in the capture grammar and capture-parse[/bold #D7AFFF]     [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]task-id-grammar[dim] · [dim][/dim]after marker[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]task-id-grammar: lex trailing ` :id` / ` ^id` tokens on project-note [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]lines, enforce the placement, validity, duplicate, checkbox, and [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]unused-`#pomodoro` rules in both the execution and editor parsers, and [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]expose spans, needs, modes, and `sub_bullet_task_ids` through [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]capture-parse.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  3 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Render named project tasks and write their Task Links[/bold #D7AFFF]         [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]task-id-execution[dim] · [dim][/dim]after task-id-grammar[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]task-id-execution: render `^id` onto named tasks (`[*]` for `:` tasks), [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]write one Task Link per `:` task into the selected Pomodoro atomically [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]with the new note, and report `project_note.task_links` in JSON and [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]human output.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  4 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Block-ID completion for project task IDs[/bold #D7AFFF]                      [bold black on #87D7FF] small  [/bold black on #87D7FF]
    [#AF87FF]task-id-completion[dim] · [dim][/dim]after task-id-grammar[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]task-id-completion: add the `project_task_block_id` capture-complete [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]context with a `block_id` object (new intent, sibling and `prj` used [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]IDs, body-derived suggestions) so editors can offer a New ID picker [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]after ` :` or ` ^`.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  5 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Capture docs for named and linked project tasks[/bold #D7AFFF]               [bold black on #87D7FF] small  [/bold black on #87D7FF]
    [#AF87FF]docs[dim] · [dim][/dim]after task-id-execution, task-id-completion[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]docs: rewrite the capture guide's grammar tables, Project notes section,[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]JSON contract, and capture-parse/capture-complete references for the new[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]syntax, with the worked example.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  6 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Bob Mac Capture support for project task links[/bold #D7AFFF]                [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]mac[dim] · [dim][/dim]after task-id-execution, task-id-completion[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]mac: in bob-mac-capture, color the new spans, route [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]`project_task_block_id` into a Project task New ID picker, fix stale `+`[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]teaching and `:` locator text, preview and notify linked tasks, update [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]README, fixtures, and tests, and land a green macOS CI run.[/#D7D7AF]
